name: HoneypotBench
description: # HoneypotBench — Complete Data and Code Release (v1.0) **Companion artefact to:** *HoneypotBench: A Curated 5-Class MITRE ATT&CK Benchmark for Evaluating Frontier Large Language Models on Cloud-Honeypot Threat Classification.* **Authors:** Sridhar G, J B Simha, Rashmi Agarwal (REVA University, Bengaluru) **Licence:** Data files (`.csv`, `.json`, `.jsonl`) under **CC-BY-4.0**. Code (`.py`) under **MIT**. Third-party rule snapshot (`emerging_rules_snapshot.tar.gz`) redistributed under its original BSD-style Emerging Threats Open license. **Cite as:** [DOI to be assigned on Zenodo publication] --- ## What this release contains A complete, reproducible artefact bundle for the HoneypotBench benchmark and every analysis reported in the manuscript. A reader can (a) inspect the benchmark itself, (b) reproduce every reported metric from the raw per-alert predictions, (c) re-run the classical baselines on their own machine in about 15 minutes, (d) extend the LLM evaluation to future frontier models, and (e) audit the multi-annotator hallucination adjudication. **All primary artefacts are included.** No files require external download except the ETOpen ruleset, which is bundled in `rules/` as the exact snapshot used to produce the reported Suricata baseline.
